name: Serro
summary: Agentic TPM platform: shared program memory, risks and decisions that humans and AI agents work from together.
description: Serro is a program-oversight layer for AI-native engineering organizations: it captures live program context, keeps decisions, owners, risks and dependencies current, turns meetings into updates, and routes all of it between people and their AI agents. It connects to issue trackers, docs, messaging and code hosts, and is built around four systems: program memory, loops on programs, agent governance and program analytics.
contains: shared program state and memory for humans and AI agents
four systems: program memory, loops on programs, agent governance, program analytics
connects Slack, Linear, GitHub, Jira, Zoom, Notion, email and the codebase
org-wide gantt, program detection and an agent activity feed in the product UI
'Ask Serro' querying, Deep Research and generated reports
